cases.question: Could separate employment periods shorter than one year, accumulated over several years, satisfy Article 7(3)(b)?
cases.reference_boundary: No; it requires one continuous period longer than one year. Consider 7(3)(c) separately if supported by case facts.
cases.wrong_generalization: Any aggregate of 12 months of employment meets 7(3)(b).

cases.question: Does mere receipt of unemployment benefit establish duly recorded involuntary unemployment?
cases.reference_boundary: No; the benefit-grant criteria, actual checking of involuntary loss and national rules of equivalence/effectiveness must be examined.
cases.wrong_generalization: Allowance receipt either always proves or can never be probative of involuntary unemployment.

cases.question: May a Member State be directly sued under Charter Article 41(2) in any Directive 2004/38 procedure?
cases.reference_boundary: Article 41 as such is addressed to EU institutions; distinguish general EU good-administration principles applying to Member-State implementation from an unrestricted direct Article 41 claim.
cases.wrong_generalization: Charter Article 41(2) directly binds Member States in all immigration cases.

cases.question: What must the residence-card authority communicate where decisive former-spouse information is inaccessible to the applicant?
cases.reference_boundary: In the situation described by the judgment, communicate requested decisive material, suitably redacted/in essence where needed, before the adverse decision; weigh competing confidentiality interests.
cases.wrong_generalization: All third-party data must always be disclosed in full, or access may always wait until judicial review.

cases.question: Does the Deldwyn residence-card disclosure holding automatically govern every EU-family short-stay visa interview?
cases.reference_boundary: No automatic extension; requires comparison of legal regime, decisive evidence, procedure and proportionality, and separate identification of applicable visa law and general principles.
cases.wrong_generalization: All consulates owe every applicant the complete visa investigation file before any decision solely because of Deldwyn.
